sect1.title: Introduction
sect1.para: The typecasting module provides a set of classes and functions for handling and converting different data types, particularly between ROOT and PyTorch tensors.

sect1.title: The variable_t Class
sect1.para: The variable_t class is a versatile data container that can hold various data types, including scalars and vectors of different dimensions. It is used to interface between the data from ROOT files and the PyTorch tensors used in the machine learning models.

listitem.para: ~variable_t(): The destructor cleans up the allocated memory.

void process(torch::Tensor* data, std::string* varname, TTree* tr): This is the main processing method. It takes a PyTorch tensor and a variable name, determines the data type and dimensions of the tensor, and stores the data in the appropriate member variable. It also creates a branch in the ROOT tree if provided.
void process(std::vector<...>* data, std::string* varname, TTree* tr): A set of overloaded methods for processing data from C++ vectors.
void build_switch(size_t s, torch::Tensor* tx): This method determines the data type and dimensionality of a PyTorch tensor and sets the type member variable accordingly.

sect1.title: The vector_cast.h Header
sect1.para: The vector_cast.h header file provides a set of template functions for casting data between different vector types.

sect1.title: The root.cxx File
sect1.para: The root.cxx file contains the implementations of the process methods for various C++ vector types. These methods are used to add data from C++ vectors to the variable_t object.
